ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a very low ratio (approx. 0.05) of high-intensity pixels localized to surface anomalies and barnacles.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray macro-region across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white rings (5-15 pixel diameter) scattered across the mid-right lobe. High density of small, high-intensity yellow-white punctate dots (1-3 pixels) concentrated on the lower left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 25 degrees; base depth is partially obscured by the fluke's vertical orientation relative to the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged profile. Right lobe exhibits low-amplitude periodic serrations. Left lobe trailing edge displays significant irregular pixel-amplitude variations and mass accumulation at the distal tip due to epibiotic load.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a sharp upward convex curve. Right lobe displays a more linear diagonal sweep with a convex taper towards the lateral tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular white rings (barnacle scars) distributed across both lobes, with a distinct grouping in the central and upper-right quadrants.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented linear disruptions (light gray) visible on the lower section of the left lobe near the peduncle connection.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes, creating irregular, high-intensity geometric protrusions that alter the natural contour.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme barnacle cluster on the upper left tip creates a unique 'club-like' silhouette, significantly deviating from the standard smooth fluke apex.
